title: Building with AI works best as a bounded change

items: Select one reviewed operation and its acceptance criteria.
Ask for an implementation diff and tests against the contract.
Run checks, inspect behaviour and record unresolved decisions.
Have the responsible people review the evidence before merging.

elements.alt: Generated conceptual APIOps scene of AI-assisted implementation and human review

elements.text: Suggested task: implement payment submission with replay and cross-partner denial tests.
